pages.text: Villages arm $(bold)Guard Villagers$() to hold a wall: hand a villager a sword or crossbow and they take the post. $(bold)Village Recruits$() lets you hire a squad: command them with $(bold)R$(), teams with $(bold)U$(), their map with $(bold)N$(), the wiki with $(bold)I$().
Recruits follow, hold, patrol and guard. They eat from their own inventory, so give them food, and they die for good, so give them armor. Pay is emeralds per hire.

Hiring is $(bold)locked$() until the Mutant Skeleton falls: the drill that made soldiers of farmers was lost with it ($(l:patchouli:tech/tier1)Tier 1$()). Guards are not locked; a wall can always be manned.$(br2)Recruits ride horses, crew ships and man cannons. They are how two players hold a town against a raid.
